decision_cruda.rationale: LH-06 is down at C564-01 (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is 11:30, and the stope holds only 216 t (about 40 oz). After repair LH-06 can muck it all by 17:00 (216 t at 42 t/h is about 5.1 h, with 5.5 h available), so waiting loses little. Central is truck-limited: inflow is 117 t/h against 91 t/h of truck capacity, and the stockpile is 298 of 450 t. An extra loader there adds almost nothing. Any loan would take a loader from a producing stope or from the DS-E543-02 heading (4 oz/h), so it would cost more than it gains. No stope is stopped, so reserves can't be activated. Decision: no moves.
